home.title: Welcome to 'Irregular Verbs Challenge'
home.subtitle: Here you can strengthen and reinforce your memory by practicing a few simple challenges.

card.title: Random irregulars
card.description: Do you know the three forms of the most common irregular verbs? Put yourself to the test. I'll give you the verb's infinitive (base form) as a hint, and you take it from there. Or you can turn on 'Expert mode', where I'll give you any of the three verb forms as a hint, and you'll complete the trio from there.
